annotation.title_clean: PL n. 370/2024 - Inclui majorante no crime de violência psicológica contra a mulher quando cometido mediante uso de inteligência artificial e aumenta a pena do crime de divulgação de cena de estupro, sexo ou pornografia
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 370/2024 - Adds an aggravating factor to the crime of psychological violence against women when committed using artificial intelligence and increases the penalty for disclosure of rape, sex or pornography scenes
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Dep. Jandira Feghali, Câmara dos Deputados (Brazil)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill PL 370/2024 amends the Penal Code to add an aggravating factor (penalty increased by half) for psychological violence against women committed using AI, and to cover AI-made deepfake sexual content in the crime of disclosing rape, sex or pornography scenes. Software-only, not embodied.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds §1 to art. 147-B of the Penal Code: penalty increased by half if psychological violence against women is committed using AI or other technology
Amends art. 218-C to cover distribution or modification of sexual content by means including AI
Penalty for art. 218-C set at 2 to 6 years' imprisonment
Justification cites AI-generated deepfake nudes of schoolgirls in Rio de Janeiro and a public figure
Takes effect on the date of publication
